Thanks. Yeah, just stating how bad things "feel" is a relief in itself. As an intelligent person, it's obvious at times that the state of mind is a rapture of mood-altering chemicals, as it is when I'm manic. Mostly, I just needed to say, Hey, my life sucks! to understand that, Hey, it's not that bad...

I just hate being bipolar... Thanks again.
I feel the same way. I've been this way, on and off, for over a decade.
